description: CFB27 META baseline (Sep 2026) for every user/CPU game. Bunch-first Wazzu/OSU-style offense; Nickel Over zone home on D. Opponent overlays stack on top; thin film stays near baseline. Patch 1.012 notes baked in.

offense_concepts.core_identity: Bunch is CFB27 passing meta — Gun Bunch X Nasty (Wazzu/OSU-style) primary; Gun Cluster changeup when Bunch overplayed.

mesh.purpose: Easy completions + man/pressure beaters; Mesh Spot is the home easy throw
mesh.when: Early downs needing a completion; vs pressure; vs C2 Invert (not Flood)

spot.purpose: Compressed rubs + intermediate sits vs zone
spot.when: Bunch/Cluster vs soft zones; RZ possession

flood.when: Confirmed Cover 3 / single-high — NOT vs Cover 6/9/Quarters

run.purpose: Force box fits; set up PA; punish two-high shells
run.when: vs Cover 6 / Cover 9 / Quarters / Palms — RUN FIRST

rpo_alert.when: Early-down mix; vs soft edge leverage

whip_hot.when: vs blitz / Cover 1 / Cover 0 — Mesh Spot first, Whip second

cluster_changeup.purpose: Break Bunch-overplay; same mesh/spot DNA from different look

rz_compressed.purpose: Possession red zone — compressed + run bully
rz_compressed.when: Inside 20; priority = possession over hero ball

constraint_pairs.why: Run to set up underneath; underneath to keep box honest
Easy throws open intermediate flood vs C3
Same family, different look when Bunch overplayed
Seams open underneath; underneath sets up shots
Pressure sellout → hot answers; hot → run again

Cover 2 / Invert Hard Flat.note: Soft lean Mesh Spot/IZ — film INTs on Whip/Flood

Cover 1 / Pressure / Cover 0.note: Hot ready; Mesh Spot primary, Whip secondary

defense_concepts.core_identity: Nickel Over zones home — force long drives; explosives kill you more than dinks. Cover 6/9 awareness: users live there — force runs.

4-3 Even 6-1.purpose: True short / GL only — no auto RUN-IN on one IZ tell

downhill_run.shell: Cover 3 Sky fit; Even 6-1 if short+repeated

defense_concepts.cover_6_9_awareness: Users live in Cover 6/9 — on OUR offense run first; on OUR defense do not gift explosives chasing; force them into long drives and underneath.

offense_gameplan.two_high_rule: CFB27: Run first vs Cover 6 / Cover 9 / Cover 4 Quarters / Palms. Prefer Inside Zone, HB Base, Counter Y from Gun Bunch X Nasty before forcing Mesh Post or Deep Flood. Users live in C6/C9 — punish with run.

pressure_answers.label: Mesh Spot (quick)
pressure_answers.note: Primary pressure answer — easy completion under heat

pressure_answers.label: Whip Trail
pressure_answers.note: Secondary pressure / man answer — whip then trail

pressure_answers.label: HB Base protection
pressure_answers.note: When pressure is selling out — run behind protection (patch 1.012 run-action blocking improved)

red_zone.note: RZ compressed + possession. Tag by coverage — C2 Invert Hard Flat ≠ always whip (film INTs). Prefer Mesh Spot / Z Spot Shake / run.

offense_gameplan.anti_repeat: Never become 80% one concept vs sticky opponent. Track last calls in-game; if same play called 2+ times in last 4 snaps, rotate to constraint family (run↔easy pass↔Cluster changeup).

short_yardage.note: Even 6-1 only true short; no auto RUN-IN on one IZ tell

goal_line.note: Heavy front; don't sell out run (Temple Z Smash lesson)

money_down.note: Patience — Cover 6/two-high patience applies to us too

vs_mesh.note: Tampa 2 / hard flats vs mesh/cross families

selective_pressure.when: 3rd-and-short with repeated pressure-worthy tendency OR high-confidence opponent archetype
selective_pressure.note: Selective — not every snap. One user job on hot.

CROSS.when_to_arm: After 2+ live Cross Wheels / crosser tells in similar D&D

VERT.when_to_arm: After 2+ live Four Verticals / seam tells in similar D&D

RPO.when_to_arm: After repeated RPO bubble / alert wins

SCRAM.purpose: Contain integrity when QB escape beats coverage carry

RUN-IN.when_to_arm: After repeated downhill run AND short-yardage — never one IZ tell

RUN-OUT.when_to_arm: After repeated Outside Zone / Stretch / toss

HEAT.when_to_arm: 3rd-short selective vs pressure-worthy archetype or repeated money-down need

FLOOD.when_to_arm: Reactivate only if opponent makes flood primary AND online stability re-tested

SCREEN.when_to_arm: Reactivate only if bubbles dominate after re-test

GLASS.purpose: CREATE candidate — soft zone glass vs Bunch mesh (hard flats + Tampa lean)
GLASS.when_to_arm: When Bunch mesh keeps winning vs base C3; install as custom adj

CONTAIN-SCRAM.purpose: CREATE candidate — explicit contain + spy lean (patch 1.012 contain custom adj fix)
CONTAIN-SCRAM.when_to_arm: When SCRAM alone is not enough vs dual-threat; use contain custom adj

SPOT-LOCK.purpose: CREATE candidate — lock the spot sit vs Mesh Spot spam
SPOT-LOCK.when_to_arm: When Mesh Spot is their primary easy throw

PROT.purpose: CREATE candidate — offense-side protection/hot reminder tag (not a D macro)
PROT.when_to_arm: vs pressure-heavy archetypes (Quen) — cue Mesh Spot/Whip/HB Base

macros_baseline.arm_doctrine: Macros situational, not every snap. Default = no macro. Arm only after REPEATED tendency in similar D&D/field zone. One tell = log + mild bump only. Free reign preserved — any designed call remains legal. Prepper may CREATE/EDIT/BENCH macros on the install sheet.

when_to_arm.CROSS: After 2+ live Cross Wheels / crosser tells in similar D&D
when_to_arm.VERT: After 2+ live Four Verticals / seam tells in similar D&D
when_to_arm.RPO: After repeated RPO bubble / alert wins
when_to_arm.SCRAM: After repeated QB scramble escapes beat coverage
when_to_arm.RUN-IN: After repeated downhill run AND short-yardage context — never one IZ tell
when_to_arm.RUN-OUT: After repeated Outside Zone / Stretch / toss
when_to_arm.HEAT: 3rd-short selective vs pressure-worthy archetype or repeated money-down need

macros_baseline.active_cap_note: Aidan USER online-dynasty hard cap: 8 Custom Adjustments O+D combined. EA UI may show 10 — honor 8. CPU may note separately; default still 8. In-game: LB opens Active macros. Path: Create & Share → Custom Adjustments.

meta_notes: v1.4.1: USER Active Custom Adjustments hard-capped at 8 O+D (Aidan). Click-to-copy macros in prep browser. Validation badges proven|meta_grounded|failed|unvalidated. Workflow: bring meta_grounded into game → if cooked, postgame adjust → if holds, mark proven.
CFB27 (2026-09): Bunch is the passing meta — Gun Bunch X Nasty (Wazzu/OSU-style) primary; Gun Cluster changeup when Bunch overplayed.
Offense families: mesh / spot / flood. Run first vs Cover 6 / Cover 9 / Quarters. Mesh Spot + Whip vs pressure. RZ = compressed + possession.
Defense: Nickel Over zones home. Cover 6/9 awareness (common user shell — force runs). Tampa 2 / hard flats vs mesh/cross. Selective 3-3 Cub / Mug pressure. Even 6-1 short yardage. Dime on true long.
Macros KEEP: CROSS VERT BUNCH RPO SCRAM RUN-IN RUN-OUT HEAT. BENCH FLOOD + SCREEN until online-stable. Prep may CREATE GLASS / CONTAIN-SCRAM / SPOT-LOCK / PROT.
Patch 1.012 (Sep 22 2026): improved run-action blocking; reduced QB spin effectiveness; contain custom adj fix — lean run-action more; scram less spin-hero; CONTAIN-SCRAM installs cleaner.
Constraint theory: run ↔ easy pass ↔ Cluster changeup. Do not spam one family. Anti-repeat + PIVOT on 3-fail streaks.
Soft competitive meta only — Xbox formation/play/macro NAMES. No invented PlayStation or Xbox button sequences.
Every game starts from this baseline. Opponent overlays + install diffs adjust as snaps accumulate; thin film stays near baseline.
